cards.f: 2 · Dentate line — 3–4 cm long, extends from the anorectal ring to the anal verge.?

cards.f: 3 · Internal sphincter — 3–4 cm long, extends from the anorectal ring to the anal verge.?

cards.f: 4 · External sphincter — 3–4 cm long, extends from the anorectal ring to the anal verge.?

cards.f: 5 · Anorectal ring — 3–4 cm long, extends from the anorectal ring to the anal verge.?

cards.f: 2 · Open haemorrhoidectomy — Outpatient, targets grade II to III; avoid in patients on anticoagulants.?
cards.b: Excises redundant tissue, wound left open; most effective for grade III to IV.

cards.f: 3 · Stapled haemorrhoidopexy — Outpatient, targets grade II to III; avoid in patients on anticoagulants.?
cards.b: Repositions prolapsing tissue with a circular stapler; less pain, but higher long-term recurrence.

cards.f: 4 · Thrombosed external pile — Outpatient, targets grade II to III; avoid in patients on anticoagulants.?
cards.b: Excise under local anaesthetic if the patient presents within 48 to 72 hours of onset.

cards.f: 5 · Laser haemorrhoidoplasty — Outpatient, targets grade II to III; avoid in patients on anticoagulants.?
cards.b: Diode laser shrinks the vascular cushions with minimal excision; quicker recovery, but higher cost and less long-term data.

cards.f: 6 · Operative principle — Outpatient, targets grade II to III; avoid in patients on anticoagulants.?
cards.b: Preserve anoderm bridges between excision sites to reduce the risk of anal stenosis.

cards.f: 4 · Off-midline fissures — Hard stool trauma tears the anoderm; internal sphincter spasm follows, reducing anodermal blood flow; ischaemia perpetuates the tear and prevents healing.?

cards.f: 3 · Posterior midline — Under 6 weeks duration; slit-like tear; heals with conservative measures in most patients.?
cards.b: Roughly 90% of fissures sit here; relative ischaemia of the posterior anoderm is the likely cause.

cards.f: 4 · Off-midline or multiple fissures — Under 6 weeks duration; slit-like tear; heals with conservative measures in most patients.?
